# Screenshot designing checklist (review template)

**Agents:** Do not edit this file under `.claude/skills/screenshot-designing/`. Use this **after** **`validate-rules` exits 0** for the active panel — the checklist is **not** a substitute for running **`validate-rules`**. A one-line “looks good” **does not** replace explicit PASS/FAIL per row.

**Rules:** Use the **exact** `##` headings below. Replace `—` with real values from the run (`panel_index`, preview path or notes).

---

## 0. Per-panel gate (required before next panel)

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `validate-rules` exit code | **0** (required — if not run or non-zero, **stop**; do not start next panel) |
| Failed check IDs (if any retries) | — |
| Preview PNG path used | — e.g. `output/temp/panel0.png` |
| `--panel-data` path | — e.g. `output/temp/strip.json` |

---

## 1. Active scope (single-panel default)

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Active `panel_index` (0-based) | — |
| Cross-panel exception | **no** (default) or **yes** — if yes, one-line rationale: — |

Unless **Cross-panel exception** is **yes** with a rationale, this review pass covers **only** the active panel’s composition; ops in the last batch should have targeted that column only.

---

## 2. Layout criteria (manual / toolkit-assisted)

**`validate-rules`** covers overlap, margins, text↔device gap, device sizing, etc. Use this section for visual judgment (including legibility).

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Preview artifact | — (e.g. path or “stdout PNG”) |
| Notes | — |

---

## 3. Toolkit-inspired criteria (per active panel)

Use **layout-reference** for numeric bands (safe margins, device height ratio, contrast). Map issues to concrete **`enqueue-op`** fixes.

| Check | PASS / FAIL | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Title:** exactly **one** text layer with sanitized report **Title** (no `\n` in content; one line when feasible) | — | — |
| **Subtitle:** exactly **one** text layer with sanitized report **Subtitle** (no `\n` in content; one line when feasible) | — | — |
| **Caption (description):** optional — if omitted, note “skipped”; if present, sanitized **Description** | — | — |
| Text layers: no bbox overlap with each other **in the same strip column** | — | — |
| Text: inside safe zone / margins for its panel | — | — |
| Text: legibility vs background | — | Eyeball only; not in `validate-rules` |
| Artboard background | — | Theme-mixed gradient: stops derived from report **Primary** / **Secondary** (not generic slate); note P/S → stop mapping |
| Text: horizontal span sensible vs panel width | — | — |
| Text vs device: **no** bbox overlap | — | — |
| Device height ~**75–90%** of canvas (panel) height | — | Visual check on preview |
| Text ↔ device: no excessive vertical dead space | — | **`validate-rules`** → **`text_device_vertical_gap`**; move device up or copy block closer |
| Device pairs: low overlap if multiple devices | — | — |

---

## 4. Visual polish (active panel)

| Check | PASS / FAIL | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text vertical rhythm | — | Not every panel needs copy hugging the **top**; varied placement OK if hierarchy stays clear and §2 overlap/safe-zone checks pass |
| Hierarchy readable | — | — |
| Spacing and alignment feel intentional | — | — |
| Composition reflects **Summary for designer** for this panel (planning-agent column) | — | Brief quote or paraphrase in Notes |
| Device + text story matches report **Title** / **Subtitle** (description only if caption layer used) | — | — |

---

## 5. Next actions

- If any **FAIL**: bundle **all** fixes into **one repair `batch`** (see skill **§ Validation-aware planning**), then **one** re-preview + **`validate-rules`** (≤ 2 validate cycles per panel).
- If all **PASS**: advance to the **next** `panel_index` until every panel is done, then ship.
